Ask one question of the resolved call/type graph

Usage: ryii graph [OPTIONS] <--callers <[PATH#]NAME>|--uses <NAME>|--from <[PATH#]NAME>|--call-path <[PATH#]NAME>|--type-path <[PATH#]NAME>|--flow-path <BLOB@START:END>|--slice <PATH:BYTE>> [PATH]...

Arguments:
  [PATH]...  Files, directories, or globs; - reads a path list from stdin

Options:
      --fast-receivers <written>    Resolve written receiver types in fast mode
      --pattern <GLOB>              Keep files matching GLOB under each directory input; repeatable
      --entry <FILE>                Run on the files FILE reaches over imports (universe: the PATH inputs, else FILE's project)
      --depth <N>                   Import hops from --entry
      --root <DIR>                  Corpus root
      --callers <[PATH#]NAME>       Resolved call edges landing on NAME; PATH#NAME keeps NAME declared in files whose path ends with PATH
      --uses <NAME>                 Declarations that reference type NAME
      --from <[PATH#]NAME>          Everything NAME reaches along call edges; PATH#NAME seeds only NAME declared in files whose path ends with PATH
      --call-path <[PATH#]NAME>     Shortest call paths from NAME; PATH#NAME seeds only NAME declared in files whose path ends with PATH
      --type-path <[PATH#]NAME>     Shortest type-reference paths from NAME; PATH#NAME seeds only NAME declared in files whose path ends with PATH
      --flow-path <BLOB@START:END>  Flow paths from PATH@START:END or BLOB@START:END. START/END are zero-based UTF-8 byte offsets, END exclusive. PATH is read under --root (or the current directory); --at reads the revision. BLOB is the exact tagged content digest from file.digest or flow_edge.from_blob (blake3:HEX for worktree facts), not a bare git object ID. Follows local df edges and interprocedural flow_edge facts from the asked node only. --reverse answers what reaches the node
      --reverse                     Follow incoming value-flow edges to answer what reaches the seed
      --slice <PATH:BYTE>           Control-dependence slice at PATH:BYTE
      --sqlite <PATH>               Keep the fact store in a new SQLite database at PATH
      --slow                        Walk the SCIP oracle's edges (ryi slow) instead of the syntax resolve
      --timeout <SECS>              Seconds the question may run; past it graph exits 3 [default: 30]
      --at <REV>                    Query a committed revision
      --compare <REV>               Diff the answers against REV
      --scip-index <FILE>           Load this index.scip
      --rust-checker                Add rust-analyzer type evidence
      --ts-checker                  Add TypeScript checker type evidence
      --go-checker                  Add go/types type evidence
  -h, --help                        Print help
